The test runner doesn't recognize this project, so I'll read the cart test and source directly.
One test fails: **"applies the discount once to the subtotal"** in `test/cart.test.ts:9`. I didn't run it because the Volt test runner doesn't detect this project. I worked it out by hand from the code.

- **Why it fails:** `cartTotal` in `src/cart.ts:16` subtracts the discount once per line item (`discount * items.length`) instead of once. With items of 10×1 and 20×2, the subtotal is 50 and the 10% discount is 5. The code subtracts 5 × 2 = 10, giving 40. The test expects 45.
- **Fix direction:** change line 16 to `round2(subtotal - discount)`. I haven't made that change.

The other two cart tests (`computes a line total` and `has no discount by default`) should pass.
